featured_reviews.name: BHAGYALAKSHMI IYER
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently went to Coffee Capital with friends for coffee. The place has nice ambience and is easily accessible. I made a reservation through Zomato and had a 10% off on the bill which they honoured. Alfiya was very helpful is making the orders quick. They have very decently priced coffee and don't burn a hole in your pocket. The only issue I noticed was the constant noise of the coffee machine overtaking conversations due to the small space. Otherwise definitely worth the visit!!!

featured_reviews.review_text: It's good ,always try garlic bread for sure ,coffee items are good ,white sauce pasta is the best seller of them but need to change some things in it...need to add more items in menu . overall a ok experience 1-2 times visit is good... Clean environment

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Patade
featured_reviews.review_text: Afreen and Alfiya, the staff were very sweet and accommodating. The ambience and overall vibe of the place was quiet soothing whether it's for working/studying or chilling with friends. The food is also pretty delicious, I usually get the croisacream which is delightful combination of a chocolate croissant and ice-cream, that has to be my favourite, with some sort of iced or cold coffee. Apart from that all the coffee options on the menu sound great. The aroma of food and coffee in the café has convinced me to come back and try more stuff❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Birjandi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve stopped by Coffee Capital a few times recently, and every drink I’ve tried has been seriously good.
First up was the Mocha Chip — rich, chocolatey, and with just the right coffee kick.

The next day, I went for the Espresso Hot Chocolate. Super smooth, cozy, and perfectly balanced — not too sweet, with that deep espresso flavor coming through. Definitely a go-to for cooler days.

I also had a sip of the Coconut Espresso (wasn’t mine, but I had to try it), and it was surprisingly great. The coconut added a subtle sweetness that worked so well with the espresso — different, but in the best way.

The staff is another highlight. Muskaan was a delight on my first visit — super friendly and made the experience feel welcoming from the start. The next day, Alfiya was just as pleasant. She’s got a great vibe and really knows how to make you feel comfortable while you wait for your drink. Great service all around.

If you’re nearby, definitely check this place out. Great drinks, great vibes, and even better service.

And the vanilla latte!

featured_reviews.name: Maryam Sharif
featured_reviews.review_text: Went there yesterday and the atmosphere was so good. Ravi made sure to make us feel right at home. He was extremely friendly and jolly which made the experience even better. Madhuri/Madhvi (sorry I forgot your exact name) was so sweet and welcoming.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Sneha Chordiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this Third wave coffee and decided to try their Orange Zest Mocha. The presentation was elegant and the citrus aroma was pleasantly inviting. The infusion of orange added a subtle brightness to the richness of the chocolate, creating an interesting flavor profile.

However, considering the price point, the overall experience felt fairly average. While the beverage was enjoyable, it lacked the depth and indulgence one would expect at that range. A slightly bolder mocha base or a more pronounced orange note could have elevated it beautifully.

That said, the ambience and service were delightful, making it a comfortable place to unwind. With a bit more refinement in the signature drinks, this café has the potential to truly impress.

featured_reviews.name: Aayushi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at  Third Wave today! We ordered two ice creams and the Paneer Mexican sandwich, and everything was exceptionally good. The food was fresh, delicious, and perfectly served.

A special mention to Sarika for her sweet nature and excellent service — she was very polite, attentive, and made our visit even better. Truly appreciated her hospitality. Highly recommend this place for both the food and the warm service! 😊

featured_reviews.name: LESTER DMELLO
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Third Wave Café in Chembur and had a wonderful experience. We ordered two cappuccinos, and they were both excellent – rich flavor, creamy texture, and served at the perfect temperature. It’s clear they know their coffee well.

The ambiance really stood out – the interiors are beautifully designed with a mix of modern minimalism and cozy elements. Whether you're looking for a quiet corner to read or a casual spot to meet friends, this place hits the mark.

Overall, a perfect blend of great coffee and an aesthetic environment. Definitely recommend checking it out if you're in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Chaulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Le Cafe, Chembur for the second time, and it impressed me yet again. What really stood out this time was the menu presentation, the thoughtful way the food is served, and the overall vibe of the place. It’s truly a perfect spot to hang out with friends and enjoy a relaxed, cozy atmosphere.
This visit was special as we went during their Christmas festival, and we got to try some of their Christmas specials. The Christmas pudding was comforting and festive, the gnocchi pasta was well-cooked and flavourful, and the jacket potatoes were absolutely delicious. From the regular menu, we also tried their veg pizza, which was equally satisfying.
A special mention to the servers—they know the menu really well and are happy to guide you, which makes the experience even better. Loved the vibe once again, and I’ll definitely be visiting again! 🎄✨

featured_reviews.review_text:

The Korean chicken was so sweet that it tasted like sweet chicken....the pizza chicken tikka didnt have any makhani sauce.....
Prawns smoked ones were the only saviour in the entire course of menu we ordered from.....
Even the chocolate mousse was beyond level sweet...
It all costed us 6k with 3 cocktails for 3 people.

featured_reviews.name: Ritika
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Le Cafe and tried several dishes. The Avocado Toast with pesto was absolutely delicious — I loved it so much, even though it was a bit on the expensive side. The Mushroom Parmesan Risotto had great flavor, and the Jerk Chicken Poutine was fine as well. I also really liked the Korean Chicken Skewers; they were tasty, just a little on the sweeter side.

My favorite item of the whole visit was the Hazelnut Chocolate Mousse — it was amazing.

The ambience is great, the place feels really nice, and the service was excellent. Overall, a very enjoyable experience!

featured_reviews.name: Payal Bhuchhada
featured_reviews.review_text: The vibe is cozy, the food is fresh and full of flavor, and the service genuinely stands out. Every dish was well presented and tasted great, especially the cafe-style snacks and beverages. The staff is polite, attentive, and makes you feel welcomed from the moment you walk in. Perfect place to chill with friends, enjoy late-night cravings, or just unwind with good coffee and music. Definitely one of the most amazing cafe spots around Tilak Nagar. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Priti Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is the place where I have started visiting recently. First time when I visited, I had some cold coffee (I don't remember the name as it was recommended by the chef) which was good. He told me about his special dishes which are famous amongst youngsters and most of the people visiting Rakam's cafe and asked me to try some of his specials. I am a big momo fan and I told him that I would love to try the momos but some other day as I already had my dinner that day. He told me that he will make proper pahadi momo and I can see him making the momos. He made me taste his special chatni which was awesome.
As promised to him I visited his cafe today to taste his momos. It was the anniversay of Rakam's cafe and there were celebrations going on. After waiting for a while, finally I got my momos and I would not hesitate to say that momos were actually very delicious. I wanted to have more but looking at large crowd I decided to visit this cafe some other time. I was offered 35% off as they had anniversary lucky coupon offers for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Blue Tokai, and while I acknowledge its potential for growth and development, my overall experience fell short of expectations. Known for their exceptional coffee and food, this particular outlet failed to provide the warm and inviting atmosphere I have come to associate with the brand. Here's a breakdown of my visit:

Ambiance:
Unfortunately, the cafe lacked the inviting ambiance that I have experienced at other Blue Tokai locations. The atmosphere felt somewhat cold and impersonal, leaving much to be desired in terms of comfort and coziness.

Service:
The staff's training and courtesy left room for improvement. It seemed that they could benefit from better training to ensure a more customer-oriented approach. The lack of attentiveness and overall politeness detracted from the overall experience. This is does not apply for all the staff but for a few among them.

Food and Coffee:
The one shining aspect of my visit was the quality of the food and coffee. Blue Tokai is well-known for their excellent coffee, and it lived up to its reputation at this location as well. The food, too, was commendable and met my expectations in terms of taste and presentation.

Service Incident:
Regrettably, my experience was marred by an incident that occurred during my visit. Despite specifically ordering a combo, I did not receive the combo. To add to the disappointment, I was later asked to pay extra for the item. This lack of attention to detail and the subsequent inconvenience significantly impacted my overall perception of the cafe.

In conclusion, Blue Tokai has the potential to become a great cafe, but there are several areas that need improvement. While the coffee and food were commendable, the lackluster ambiance, poorly trained staff, and the service mishap prevented me from giving it a higher rating. I sincerely hope that Blue Tokai addresses these issues to provide a better experience for future customers.

I have been a regular customer of The East End Deli, Chembur since last year, but my recent experience has been extremely disappointing and unprofessional.

On 20th December, I personally visited the store to inquire about a 1 kg Blueberry Cheesecake for 25th December. The staff member even called his manager and confirmed that the cake would be available at a price of ₹1260, and I was clearly advised to come and book it on 24th December.

To reconfirm, I again visited the store on 22nd and 23rd December, and every time I was given the same assurance that I could book the cake on the 24th.

However, today on 24th December, when I called the store to place the booking, the staff completely denied the earlier commitment. I was told that some other colleague had the information and not him, and finally I was informed that I would not get the cake tomorrow. After this, they stopped answering my calls on both the store number and the Google Maps landline.

This is highly irresponsible and unethical behaviour. I was relying on their repeated confirmation and now I am left searching for a cake at the last moment for a special occasion.

If the product was not available, I should have been informed in advance instead of being kept on hold with false promises.

Good service and customer ethics are more important than store ambience and glamour.
This experience has completely ruined my trust in this outlet. I sincerely hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves their customer handling.

Visited Barista recently and honestly had such a comforting experience. The café has a very cozy, calm vibe that instantly makes you want to sit back, relax, and enjoy your time. It’s a great place for long conversations, casual meet-ups, or just spending some quiet time with good coffee.

The cappuccino especially stood out with its nice aroma and creamy texture.

To end the meal, we tried one of their dark, rich desserts, which was indulgent without being overly sweet — a perfect finish. Everything felt fresh and thoughtfully prepared.

What really adds to the experience is the overall ambience — soft lighting, comfortable seating, and a pleasant crowd that makes the place feel warm and welcoming. The staff was polite and attentive, which always makes a difference.

Overall, Barista is a reliable spot for good coffee, tasty food, and genuinely nice vibes. Definitely a place I’d love to visit again and recommend to anyone looking for a relaxed café experience. ☕️✨

Since it’s mango season, I was excited to try it, but it was extremely disappointing. The filling inside tasted like raw egg yolk with an overpowering eggy smell and flavour. It was so unpleasant that I actually felt sick after eating it. There was barely any sweetness, no proper lemon flavour, and the overall taste was just horrible.

On top of that, they charged ₹85 as service charge for such poor food and service. Completely not worth the money. Worst taste, worst service, and a total waste of money.
